Trademarks & Sonic Nomenclature

Proprietary Brand Identifiers (™) vs. Open Generic Genre Terms
MICHAEL P. RAGSDALE / RAGGIESOFT MEDIA

While RaggieSoft Media's code is MIT-licensed and our narrative lore is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, trademarks are maintained separately to distinguish official Michael P. Ragsdale / RaggieSoft Media / Engine Room Records™ releases from third-party works. We pair our audio trademark with an open, generic genre term that anyone in the community is free to use:

Proprietary Trademark: "The Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™"

The Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™ (and Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™) is a common-law trademark claimed by Michael P. Ragsdale (d/b/a RaggieSoft Media and Engine Room Records™) to identify official RaggieSoft audio releases engineered using our zero-gravity synth-pop production profile (such as Hard Reset, Moon 1: Sanctuary (Zero-G), and Starfield Calibration).

Open Generic Genre Name: "80s Cosmic Pop"

80s Cosmic Pop (as well as descriptive phrases like "Zero-G Synth-Pop" or "Cosmic Synth-Rock") is the generic, open genre name that Michael P. Ragsdale explicitly welcomes and encourages fellow musicians, prompt engineers, playlist curators, and fans to use freely for their own tracks and projects without restriction.

Engine Room Records™ Audio Tri-License Model

CC BY-SA 4.0 • Standard DSP Consumer License • Direct Commercial Non-Exclusive Sync
ZERO CONTENT-ID AMBUSH GUARANTEE

Every musical recording released by Engine Room Records™ (including The Stardust Engine, Fractured Prisms, The Paper Wall, Crimson Node, Mana Canvas, and The Arctic Symphony Project) is tri-licensed so listeners, independent video creators, and commercial studios each have a frictionless legal pathway:

1. CC BY-SA 4.0 (Open Culture)

Use, share, remix, and feature our music in independent YouTube videos, Twitch streams, podcasts, and community projects for free—simply credit the artist & Engine Room Records / RaggieSoft Media and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0.

2. Standard DSP License

Stream and enjoy the official masters across global Digital Service Providers (Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, Pandora, and Qobuz) or gratis via The Listening Room under standard consumer streaming terms.

3. Commercial Non-Exclusive

Need to synchronize our music into a proprietary film, commercial broadcast, or closed-source video game without CC BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike copyleft obligations? Obtain a direct Commercial Non-Exclusive Sync License from RaggieSoft Media.

Why We Never Opt Into YouTube Content ID or Meta Rights Manager ("Social Media Pack")

Automated audio-fingerprinting bots (such as DistroKid's Social Media Pack, YouTube Content ID, and Meta Rights Manager) cannot read Creative Commons attributions or verify direct commercial sync licenses—they blindly demonetize and claim every video that matches a waveform. Because our catalog is tri-licensed, RaggieSoft Media strictly opts out of automated Content ID / Rights Manager monetization so creators using our music under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a Commercial Non-Exclusive License are never ambushed by automated copyright claims.

Commercial Media Clearances

Require Engine Room Records audio for a commercial film? Adapting RaggieSoft narrative IP for a monetized product without ShareAlike restrictions? Commercial synchronization and clearance waivers are negotiated directly via our B2B portal.
